# Reuse accepted content through the existing catalog

Date: 2026-09-13. Status: accepted for the player workflow implementation.

The previously shipped companion contains a different white dog model. Mutating
that immutable version would silently replace old works. Add distinct versioned
model and module entries, preserving all twenty accepted delivery ZIP hashes.
Use the existing Rust catalog, opaque blobs, native source installer and component
state interface. No parallel asset database or whole-world replacement is added.

The model entry permits ordinary model preview and correctly claims no gameplay.
The module wraps the exact same GLB with independently persistent following,
waiting and petting. A local appearance variant duplicates materials instead of
mutating shared model resources. The small real GLB fits existing component and
archive limits; there is no reason to weaken those bounds.

Codex gains registered bounded library tools, not installation authority. Frozen
source proposals and native player-action installation stay authoritative. Retain
installation receipts in proposal projections so remounting a conversation can
observe the existing job without creating a second instance. Runtime success and
application still require their ordinary check/adoption receipts.

The archived preview documents the accepted appearance; it is not falsely inserted
as a runtime verification receipt. Model provenance states generated project content
with redistribution rights unverified; wrapper MIT does not license model bytes.
